label.+: The payoff token of a stated outcome: the word that completes the result/consequence of a conditional, causal or modal clause (would/could/will + verb + OUTCOME, 'leads to an increase in X', 'cannot be redeemed', 'contract strongly'), and in code the returned value or final statement of a branch ('return res', 'print(10)')
label.-: End of a background/descriptive expository statement that states no outcome, typically closing on a trailing adjunct or prepositional tail ('over the site.', 'from that proximity.', 'illustrated in Figure 2.'); in code, ordinary non-return statement line breaks and indentation

hypotheses.rel_pos: H1 (from corpus top examples): the payoff token of a stated outcome: the word that completes the result/consequence of a conditional, causal or modal clause, or the returned value / final statement of a code branch
hypotheses.rel_h2: H2 (refined after the bank screen): the closing object/amount (or final period) of a hypothetical projection claim that a deliberate action or intervention WOULD/COULD change a measurable quantity -- money accumulated or saved, a bill or cost reduced, efficiency/yield/return raised, risk lowered -- typically with a possessor or a number on the target ('would have close to N3,000', 'would reduce your electricity bill', 'could increase their efficiency'). Weaker for will/may/present-tense action->result statements; near-silent for natural-event conditionals, abstract economic/physical laws, descriptive mentions of the same quantities, and code returns (the corpus code/long-context peaks did not reproduce in isolation, so H2 only claims the short-sentence prose behaviour).

h2_rule: Rated from the sentence text alone. 1.0 = hypothetical modal (would/could) projection in which an action/intervention changes a measurable quantity (money amount, bill, cost, efficiency, return, yield, risk). 0.8 = would/could/can projection of an intervention whose outcome is a non-quantity benefit or harm (slow tumors, prevent infections, lungs regenerate). 0.6 = an action or intervention yields a concrete result stated with will/may or plain present tense (go stale, suffer sickness, produces a toxic gas, burns more efficiently). 0.4 = outcome of a natural event/condition or an abstract law with no agent intervention (dam fails -> flood; rates -> investment; reflex weakened -> contracts). 0.3 = explicit past or explanatory causal link without a projection (led to, because, causes). 0.2 = outcome/consequence vocabulary but no outcome actually projected (whether..., consequences unclear, what would happen, should be given attention). 0.1 = code return/print lines and faintly related prose. 0.0 = descriptive, unrelated, surface look-alikes, code definitions/imports.
